text: The national anthem of the secessionist African state of Biafra, formerly known as the Eastern Region of Nigeria, was titled "Land of the Rising Sun." The lyrics were authored by Nnamdi Azikiwe, and the melody was adapted from Jean Sibelius' "Finlandia," a choice influenced by Biafran president Emeka Ojukwu's appreciation for Sibelius's musical works. The anthem begins with the lines: "Land of the rising sun, we love and cherish, Beloved homeland of our brave heroes; We must defend our lives or we shall perish, We shall protect our hearts from all our foes; But if the price is death for all we hold dear, Then let us die without a shred of fear." It continues with: "Hail to Biafra, consecrated nation, O fatherland, this be our solemn pledge: Defending thee shall be a dedication, Spilling our blood we’ll count a privilege; The waving standard which emboldens the free Shall always be our flag of liberty." The final stanzas state: "We shall emerge triumphant from this ordeal, And through the crucible unscathed we’ll pass; When we are poised the wounds of battle to heal, We shall remember those who died in mass; Then shall our trumpets peal the glorious song Of victory we scored o’er might and wrong." The closing verses pray: "Oh God, protect us from the hidden pitfall, Guide all our movements lest we go astray; Give us the strength to heed the humanist call: To give and not to count the cost’ each day; Bless those who rule to serve with resoluteness, To make this clime a land of righteousness."
